faq.title: Questions that must be clear before the commercial progression.

startOrPro.question: Start or Pro?
startOrPro.answer: Start proves that one real business job can be assigned and create an Outcome. Pro turns a proven job into a repeatable operating rhythm.

doIHaveTo.question: Do I have to go through Start before Pro?
doIHaveTo.answer: No. Direct Pro entry is allowed after Pro Qualification when the Responsibility is supported, maturity fits and evidence is sufficient.

doesStartHaveA.question: Does Start have a trial?
doesStartHaveA.answer: Yes: the first 7 days are free and no card is needed, per the locked commercial truth.

doesProHaveIts.question: Does Pro have its own trial?
doesProHaveIts.answer: No. Pro has no separate trial; Start is the first-proof path, Pro is repeat.

ifIRunOut.question: If I run out of resources, do I have to move up to Pro?
ifIRunOut.answer: No. Usage is not maturity. The need for more usage goes to additional usage once the register and top-up price are verified.

whyIsProMore.question: Why is Pro more expensive?
whyIsProMore.answer: Pro sustains context, execution, evidence and learning across many cycles to create a reliable operating rhythm.

isSupportIncluded.question: Is support included?
isSupportIncluded.answer: Start is self-service; assisted is bought separately. Pro includes Standard Product Support but the exact scope must still be verified.

canOpcBeBought.question: Can OPC be bought yet?
canOpcBeBought.answer: Not yet. OPC is a research / hypothesis for Founder Capacity, not a current public plan.

canTeamBeBought.question: Can Team be bought yet?
canTeamBeBought.answer: Not yet. Team is a future option for coordination, not a current offer.

isEnterpriseAnUnlimited.question: Is Enterprise an Unlimited plan?
isEnterpriseAnUnlimited.answer: No. Enterprise is a target architecture for governance; it does not mean unlimited.

doesAHigherPlan.question: Does a higher plan mean a more autonomous AI?
doesAHigherPlan.answer: No. Autonomy is earned from evidence, trust and permission; it is not bought with a plan.

whatAboutVatRefunds.question: What about VAT, refunds and proration?
whatAboutVatRefunds.answer: No policy has been published yet. Pricing does not infer these terms.
